overview_description.description:
Shef is a homemade food marketplace that helps local cooks to make a meaningful income from home by selling authentic, homemade dishes to their neighbors.

The company was founded by Alvin Salehi and Joey Grassia in 2019 and operates in seven markets, including San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Chicago, and Los Angeles.

about_short_description.short_description: Shef is a homemade food marketplace that helps cooks make an income by cooking and selling food to their communities.

product.name: Shef Homemade Food Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace where customers browse and order meals prepared by local home cooks, with delivery to supported locations.

product.name: Shef Food Delivery
product.description: A delivery service for prepared homemade meals ordered through Shef, serving eligible cities, neighborhoods, and ZIP codes.

product.name: Become a Shef
product.description: A platform service that enables home cooks to join Shef, list homemade dishes, and earn income from food orders in their communities.

product.name: Shef Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for browsing Shef dishes and local cooks, placing food orders, and managing homemade food delivery.

product.name: Shef Gift Cards
product.description: Gift cards that allow recipients to purchase eligible homemade meals and food delivery orders through Shef.
